scene1_screen1.text: The plane rumbles gently as passengers shuffle into their seats. Overhead bins slam shut, flight attendants smile with practiced ease, and outside the window, the sky glows in that dreamy twilight between day and night.

scene1_screen2.text: A woman pauses in the aisle, ticket in hand. Her name is Claire — composed, travel-worn, but undeniably elegant. Wavy auburn hair tucked behind one ear, an oversized scarf around her neck, and that quiet look of someone who needed this flight… badly.

scene1_screen4.text: She reaches her row and freezes.

scene1_screen5.text: Already in the window seat: a man with a casual half-smile and headphones around his neck. That kind of smile that says he knows exactly how charming he is. He looks up from his book — dark, well-read eyes meet hers.

scene1_screen8.text: Ethan stands, polite and easygoing as he lets her in. His voice is smooth, like late-night radio.

scene1_screen9.text: Looks like we’re stuck together for the next thirteen hours. Hope you don’t snore.

scene1_screen10.text: (flatly) Only when I dream of awkward conversations with strangers.

scene1_screen11.text: They settle in. The safety video plays. Somewhere in the background, a baby starts to cry.

scene1_screen12.text: Claire pulls out a book. Ethan opens a bag of sour candies and offers her one without looking.

scene1_screen14.text: She hesitates… then accepts. Their fingers brush. Her lips twitch into a reluctant smile.

scene1_screen15.text: Fine. But no talking until snack service.

scene1_screen17.text: The plane lifts into the sky. A soft hum fills the air. Clouds rush by the window like silent witnesses.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Claire flips open her book, eyes scanning the page — but her thoughts wander. She steals a glance at Ethan. He’s watching the clouds, quiet, content.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (reading aloud without meaning to) "...and she realized, in that moment, silence could be its own kind of intimacy."

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Ethan glances over, surprised — and then nods.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen5.text: Claire blushes slightly and hides behind her book.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (grinning) Bit of both. I’m a travel photographer. Always working, always chasing sunsets. You?

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Marketing. Or… escaping marketing, technically. I needed a break.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Smart. The world’s too wide to stay stuck.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen6.text: She turns to look out the window, but the corner of her mouth lifts slightly.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: If you’re going to flirt, at least be original.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Only slightly. You’ve got until beverage service to impress me.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: I feel like you’re secretly grading this conversation.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen6.text: Oh, I am. But you’re holding a strong B+.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen7.text: She crosses her arms and leans back, but her smile gives her away.

scene1_screen18.text: The hours drift on, the sky outside deepens into velvet blue. The meal trays are cleared, most passengers nod off, but Claire and Ethan are still talking — quieter now, closer.

scene1_screen19.text: A second round of drinks appears without request. Neither of them seems ready to let the conversation end.

scene2_screen1.text: Cabin lights dim. Most passengers have fallen asleep or tucked into movies. The world outside is dark velvet sprinkled with stars. A gentle clink of glassware is the only sign that the galley is still awake.

scene2_screen2.text: Claire and Ethan sit closer now, shoulders brushing lightly as they share a mini bottle of champagne and two tiny plastic flutes.

scene2_screen4.text: To snark, sweets, and surviving long-haul flights.

scene2_screen5.text: They toast. The bubbles fizz softly between them. Their voices fall into a relaxed rhythm, filled with half-whispers and grinning side-eyes.

scene2_screen6_1.text: The slight turbulence they encountered on the plane seemed to have made Claire nervous. Seeing this, Ethan lightly touched her shoulder.

scene2_screen7_1.text: Hey, it's okay! We can chat to clear our heads.

scene2_screen6.text: Okay. Tell me about your worst coworker.

scene2_screen7.text: Easy. Guy named Travis. Brought tuna sandwiches on jungle shoots. In the tropics. Every. Time.

scene2_screen8.text: Claire snorts with laughter, covering her mouth with the back of her hand.

scene2_screen9.text: My turn. Melissa. From HR. Sends inspirational cat memes... as meeting invites.

scene2_screen10.text: Ethan groans in sympathy, dramatically clutching his chest.

scene2_screen12.text: Their giggles taper off into silence, but a warm one. He looks at her, a little longer this time.

opts.text: Offer your hand — a silent invitation.
Whisper something cheeky in her ear.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Ethan slowly turns his palm upward, resting it between them. He doesn't look at Claire, just keeps his eyes forward, the gesture open, quiet.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Claire glances down, her expression unreadable for a moment. Then her fingers find his, delicate and sure. Their hands stay there, not gripping — just existing, touching.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Neither of them says anything. It’s a pact of silence that means everything.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: He shifts slightly so their shoulders are flush. Claire leans the tiniest bit closer, like a secret being told without words.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Ethan leans closer, his voice low and teasing.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Just so you know… if the kiss comes with complimentary pretzels, I’m all in.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Claire lets out a startled laugh, turning toward him, eyes gleaming.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Too bad. You only get me — limited edition. No snacks included.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: He grins like a man who just hit turbulence and loved it.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen6.text: The space between them vanishes, thick with that brand of ridiculous affection that feels like summer air.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Ethan gives her a gentle nudge with his shoulder, playful and testing.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: You’re trouble. You know that, right?

scene2_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Lucky for you, I’m first-class trouble stuck in economy.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: He laughs, head thrown back a little too dramatically. Claire tries to shush him through her giggles, only making it worse.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen5.text: A passenger coughs in protest two rows back, which just makes them snort harder.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (shrugging) Reckless behavior. We’re a safety announcement waiting to happen.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen7.text: And I didn’t even wear my seatbelt.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen8.text: They bump shoulders again, this time softer. The moment between them hums.

scene2_screen13.text: Her hand rests near his, almost touching. A quiet beat. Then — a soft, unhurried kiss. Barely more than a brush, but enough to change the air between them.

scene2_screen14.text: They pull back, smiling at the ridiculousness of it all — just in time to hear a sharp whisper.

scene2_screen15.text: (sharp whisper) Folks, some people are trying to sleep.

scene2_screen16.text: Claire covers her face in mock shame. Ethan mouths "sorry" like a teenager caught passing notes.

scene2_screen17.text: They stifle their laughter and settle down. Claire leans toward him, whispering something that makes him chuckle again.

scene2_screen18.text: They put on the same movie, earbuds shared. Somewhere over the ocean, sleep drapes gently over them, heads tilted toward one another.

scene3_screen1.text: Bright lights. The echo of suitcase wheels. Announcements blaring in three languages. The chaos of arrival feels surreal after the hush of the sky.

scene3_screen2.text: Claire and Ethan stand near the baggage carousel, coffees in hand, looking a little rumpled but entirely amused.

scene3_screen5.text: Their bags slide into view. Claire grabs hers, hesitating for just a moment.

scene3_screen6.text: So. This is where the movie ends, huh?

opts.text: Make him laugh — then seal it with a kiss.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: You still owe me an in-flight dessert.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: I'll bake you cookies. Midair. Just say the word.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Claire steps forward and kisses him — a soft, confident brush of lips that leaves them both a little breathless.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen6.text: See you in the sequel, aisle buddy.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen2.text: She hands him a folded paper — a boarding pass with her number scribbled across it.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Just in case you need a travel buddy again.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Ethan smiles, surprised and undeniably charmed.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen5.text: I’ll keep it in my passport. Lucky charm.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Claire leans in, whispers something that makes him chuckle… and plants a kiss on his cheek, playful and sweet.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Claire takes a few steps back, waving with her coffee cup.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen2.text: If we were in a romcom, this is where I'd turn around dramatically and run back.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Then I’ll just trust the universe has a part two planned.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen5.text: She turns, walks off with that unshakable, slow-building smile. Ethan watches her go — then shouts:

scene3_choice1_option3_screen7.text: She waves it in the air without turning.

scene3_screen8.text: They stand a beat longer — then part ways in the slow, clunky rhythm of airports. But something lingers.

scene3_screen9.text: Whatever last flight meant, this moment feels different. And sometimes the only way to know what it truly means is to stay close and keep talking.
